root_cause: During the 'CMake configure, build and install - OpenVINO JS API' step, the build re-runs cmake with -UTBB* and a reduced option set (CPACK_GENERATOR=NPM, ENABLE_SYSTEM_TBB=OFF, ENABLE_WHEEL=OFF) against the SAME build directory used by the earlier full configure. This reconfigure regenerates the precompiled header source/flags for openvino_reference without correctly regenerating (or invalidating stale cached) cmake_pch.hxx.gch, so GCC's -Winvalid-pch check rejects the now-mismatched .gch artifact as 'not a PCH file', and -Werror promotes it to a hard failure across dozens of independent translation units. This is the same long-standing recurring pattern (11 occurrences since 2026-09-24, 8 in the last 24h) affecting only the ARM64 cross-compilation Build job's JS API reconfigure step; it is not caused by this PR's changes (test-only PyTorch TorchBench changes, no CMake/core files touched).
reproduction_steps: N/A (CI-only: requires the ARM64 cross-compile toolchain and the two-stage cmake reconfigure sequence used by the 'CMake configure, build and install - OpenVINO JS API' step; not practically reproducible in a standard dev environment without replicating the exact sccache + PCH cache state).
recommended_actions: Have the JS API reconfigure step pass -DENABLE_PCH=OFF (or clear/regenerate the PCH) when it reuses the existing openvino_build directory with a reduced option set, since the PCH was compiled under different build flags.
Alternatively, invalidate/remove stale cmake_pch.hxx.gch files under openvino_build/src/core/reference/ before the second cmake --build invocation in the JS API step.
Re-run the failed jobs for this PR; this is a known infra-level flake unrelated to the PR diff.
Track root-cause fix for the underlying CMake JS API reconfigure script (likely in cmake/ or the JS API CMakeLists) separately from this PR.
prevention_strategies: Avoid reusing the same CMake build directory across configure passes with different ENABLE_* option sets; use a dedicated build directory (or force a clean regenerate of PCH-dependent files) for the JS API reconfigure step so GCC's PCH consistency check never observes mismatched .gch state.
historical_context: Same signature (5b4b1e6917a69856) recorded 11 times since 2026-09-24T23:04:41Z, most recently at 2026-10-06T12:10:34Z (run 37457680616), affecting many unrelated PRs (#37717, #38261, #37908, #38604, #38607, #38611, #38030, #38483, #38380, #38393). This is a persistent infra-level issue in the ARM64 cross-compilation Build job, not specific to this PR.
